tables.vehicle_maintenance_document:
CREATE TABLE vehicle_maintenance_document (
	id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	company_code VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL, 
	vehicle_record_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	maintenance_record_id INTEGER, 
	inspection_record_id INTEGER, 
	source_draft_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	source_record_index INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	pending_record_id VARCHAR(36), 
	related_document_id VARCHAR(36), 
	payload_json TEXT NOT NULL, 
	decision_json TEXT NOT NULL, 
	financial_status VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL, 
	parts_status VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL, 
	created_by_username VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	reviewed_by_username VARCHAR(100), 
	reviewed_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_maintenance_document_source UNIQUE (company_code, source_draft_id, source_record_index), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_maintenance_document_target CHECK ((maintenance_record_id IS NOT NULL AND inspection_record_id IS NULL) OR (maintenance_record_id IS NULL AND inspection_record_id IS NOT NULL)), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_maintenance_document_financial_status CHECK (financial_status IN ('pending','confirmed','duplicate','superseded','excluded')), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_maintenance_document_parts_status CHECK (parts_status IN ('pending','confirmed','not_applicable')), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_maintenance_document_source_index CHECK (source_record_index >= 0), 
	FOREIGN KEY(vehicle_record_id) REFERENCES vehicle (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(maintenance_record_id) REFERENCES vehicle_maintenance_record (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(inspection_record_id) REFERENCES vehicle_periodic_inspection_record (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(source_draft_id) REFERENCES vehicle_document_import_draft (id), 
	UNIQUE (pending_record_id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(pending_record_id) REFERENCES vehicle_import_pending_record (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(related_document_id) REFERENCES vehicle_maintenance_document (id)
)
